title: Monitoring router: a not-ready output no longer halts the sweep; Data Parade back in live routing
description: A bound publication whose Cyclotron output is pending_criteria (Data Parade) made decide answer HTTP 409 'publication criteria are pending', and the router stopped the whole sweep. Now a per-binding skip: BindingNotReady, PARK#<pub> with 30 min to 6 h backoff, newest 25 items parked and backfilled when ready, waitingForClassifier on the run receipt and Monitoring page. Follow-ups found in release: the real 409 is a FastAPI detail body, not a typed code (PR #495); resumed routes failed to save floats (PR #497). PRs #490, #495, #497; promotes #492, #494, #498. Deployed router-only by change set to papyrus-monitoring; data-parade re-added to CONFIG#router; two clean live cycles (22:37Z, 22:52Z) with Anth.us, p.apyr.us and Threat Intelligence deciding and Data Parade waiting for classifier, zero Lambda errors.
